sql: WITH tk AS (SELECT DISTINCT market_ticker FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Alimm1' AND action='buy' AND created_at > '2026-10-28' AND (market_ticker LIKE 'KXMAMDANI%' OR market_ticker LIKE 'KXYTVIEWSHIGH-%26DEC%' OR market_ticker LIKE 'KXTRUMPMENTION%')), s AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.market_ticker, date_trunc('hour', s.at), floor(extract(minute from s.at)/10)) s.* FROM incentive_market_snapshots s WHERE s.market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM tk) AND s.at > '2026-10-28' ORDER BY s.market_ticker, date_trunc('hour', s.at), floor(extract(minute from s.at)/10), s.at), j AS (SELECT s.market_ticker, s.at, p.end_date, p.period_reward_usd / greatest(extract(epoch from (p.end_date-p.start_date))/3600.0,1) pph, o.quantity, CASE WHEN o.side='yes' THEN s.est_yes_score_total ELSE s.est_no_score_total END fld, o.kalshi_order_id koid FROM s JOIN incentive_programs p ON p.id=s.program_row_id JOIN LATERAL (SELECT o2.side, o2.quantity, o2.kalshi_order_id FROM live_orders o2 WHERE o2.strategy='Alimm1' AND o2.action='buy' AND o2.market_ticker=s.market_ticker AND o2.created_at<=s.at ORDER BY o2.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) o ON true WHERE s.at < p.end_date) SELECT j.market_ticker t, to_char(max(j.end_date),'MM-DD') pend, count(*) buckets, round(sum(j.pph * least(0.5, j.quantity/nullif(j.fld,0)) / 2 / 6.0)::numeric, 2) est_usd FROM j WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fills f WHERE f.kalshi_order_id=j.koid AND (f.raw_fill_json::json->>'created_time')::timestamptz <= j.at) GROUP BY j.market_ticker ORDER BY 2,1
